overview: Published counts differ: the current website describes 63 residences; the original factsheet lists 56. Obtain the approved current schedule.
research.priceNote: The current developer headline is AED 2,149,000; its FAQ rounds this to AED 2.1m. Price and available units require a fresh quotation.

research.paymentNote: Website: 15% down payment + 5% in month four + 10% on handover + 70 monthly payments of 1% = 100%. Original sheet: 60/40 for 1–2BR; 50/50 for 3–4BR. Confirm applicable terms.
